module: GE extension `core_flowgraphManager`: manager of the running Flowgraph projects (node-based visual scripts). It creates, loads, starts, deletes and serializes `manager` objects (one per .flow.json project), provides the catalogs of available nodes and state templates for the editor, and exposes helpers `_flowgraph_createNode / _flowgraph_createStateNode / _flowgraph_createModule` that node files use to declare themselves. A modder uses it to launch a flowgraph project by script or to find a node/module of an active project.
usage:
local mgr, ok = core_flowgraphManager.loadManager('/flowgraphEditor/monProjet.flow.json')
if ok then mgr:setRunning(true) end
-- single shared project (flowgraphEditor/<name>.flow.json), started automatically
local s = core_flowgraphManager.getSingleton('monProjet')
notes: A 'manager' is an object created by require('/lua/ge/extensions/flowgraph/manager')(M): fields seen here: id, graphs[graphId].nodes[nodeId], modules[name], hidden, transient, savedDir, savedFilename, stopRunningOnClientEndMission; methods seen: setRunning, destroy, historySnapshot, broadcastCall, resolveHooksAndReset, _onSerialize/_onDeserialized. Their details are in the flowgraph/ folder.

Managers with deferred start (startNextFrame) are launched at the next onUpdate; those in startOnLoadingScreenFadeout are launched when the onLoadingScreenFadeout hook is received and are marked stopRunningOnClientEndMission.

onSerialize/onDeserialized are used when extensions are reloaded and also by reInitOnFileChange: modifying a node file (flowgraph/nodes or a *Node.lua of a project's customNodes folder) reloads all managers.
'transient' managers are not serialized; 'singletons' (getSingleton) are found again by name after a reload and restarted.

Inconsistencies: the comment of getNextUniqueIdentifier says 'do not use ever'; getAvailableStateTemplates uses stateData.name which is never defined (so the last element of splitPath is not added) and builds sourcePath with the .lua extension whereas they are .flow.json files; mgrRunningChanged is an empty, non-exported local; the onFlowgraphSceneObjectAdd/Remove/Changed hooks only dump() to the console.
Fields: M.dependencies is not defined at creation, but by refreshDependencies() (keys of runningProxies).

runningProxies.desc: Running proxy extensions; their keys are used to recompute M.dependencies (refreshDependencies).

enableUsageTracking.desc: Usage tracking flag (false by default); read by other flowgraph modules.

skipCountdowns.desc: Flag to ignore countdowns (false by default); read by other flowgraph modules.

refreshDependencies.desc: Recomputes M.dependencies from the keys of M.runningProxies.

getNextUniqueIdentifier.desc: Unique identifier counter incremented on every call. The code says "do not use ever": reserved for the flowgraph implementation.

getAllManagers.desc: List of all active managers (direct reference to the internal table).

getManagerByID.desc: Looks up a manager by its id.

getManagerGraphNode.desc: Safely retrieves a node of a graph of an active manager; nil if one of the ids is invalid (preferable to direct access getManagerByID(m).graphs[g].nodes[n]).

getManagerModule.desc: Retrieves a module of an active manager by its name; nil if absent.

loadManager.desc: Creates a manager and loads a .flow.json project into it. The manager is added to the list even if the file is not found (error logged, empty manager).

keepSavedDirs.desc: true = keeps the file's savedDir/savedFilename instead of those of filepath.

returns.desc: true if the file was read.

addManager.desc: Creates a manager, optionally from already decoded data, and adds it to the list. Does not start it.

removeManager.desc: Destroys a manager and removes it from the list and from the singletons. No effect if the manager is not found (compared by id).

clearAllManagers.desc: Destroys all managers and clears the list.

startNextFrame.desc: Schedules setRunning(true) of a manager at the next onUpdate.

removeNextFrame.desc: Schedules the deletion of a manager at the next onUpdate (avoids destroying a manager while it is running).

startOnLoadingScreenFadeout.desc: Queues a manager to start at the end of the loading screen (onLoadingScreenFadeout hook), used by projects launched automatically with a level.

getSingleton.desc: Returns the single manager of this name; if it does not exist yet, loads it from 'flowgraphEditor/<name>.flow.json', starts it and stores it.

returns.desc: Manager; nil if the file is not found.

getAvailableNodeTemplates.desc: Recursively scans '/lua/ge/extensions/flowgraph/nodes/' (*.lua), loads them with require (errors are logged and the node is skipped) and builds a category tree and a flat table. Result cached until a node file is modified.

returns.desc: Flat table path -> template (added fields: path, sourcePath, splitPath, availablePinTypes).

getAvailablePinTypes.desc: Input/output pin types of a node according to its pinSchema; adds 'flow' as input and output for non-simple functional nodes (via ui_flowgraph_editor).

getAvailableStateTemplates.desc: Scans '/flowgraphEditor/states/' (*state.flow.json), reads each file and builds a tree and a flat table of state templates. Files directly at the root of the folder are ignored.

returns.desc: Flat table path -> {data, path, sourcePath, splitPath}.

controls.desc: Broadcasts to all managers the control event 'onControlsReset' (name = 'reset') or 'onControlsAction' (name = 'action').

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook on load: defines the global functions _flowgraph_createNode, _flowgraph_createStateNode and _flowgraph_createModule (rawset in _G) used by the node/module files.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: resolves pending hooks and resets each manager, starts/deletes the scheduled ones then broadcasts 'onFlowgraphManagerPreUpdate' to each.

onLoadingScreenFadeout.desc: Hook at the end of the loading screen: starts the managers of the startOnLoadingScreenFadeout list.

onFileChanged.desc: File modification hook: if a base node or a '*Node.lua' of an active project's customNodes folder changes, reloads (serializes/deserializes) all managers.

onSerialize.desc: Save hook before extensions reload: serializes the non-transient managers and the singletons index.

onDeserialized.desc: Restore hook: destroys the managers, recreates them from the data, restarts the singletons.

onFlowgraphSceneObjectAdd.desc: Hook called when a flowgraph scene object is added: only displays a debug dump.

onFlowgraphSceneObjectRemove.desc: Hook for removal of a flowgraph scene object: debug dump only.

onFlowgraphSceneObjectChanged.desc: Hook for modification of a flowgraph scene object: debug dump only.
